key_observations_html:
• Crypto total market cap fell 10.3% over 30D: Total crypto market cap at $2.73T (10.3% lower over 30D). Related: What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms? (CoinTelegraph).
  • Losses broadened among top-50 alts: 3 names up more than ~0.5%, 35 down more than ~0.5%, and 4 roughly flat out of 42 non-stable coins with a valid 1M % (top-50 table). Related: Mercado Bitcoin pledges to cover all user losses after near $40 million hack (CoinDesk).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June (CoinTelegraph).
  • Regulatory framing still decides product access: Enforcement and legislation shocks tend to pull risk into majors first, while higher-beta categories retrace until policy clarity returns. Related: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes (CoinTelegraph).
